# Cannot compute: CN 7208 is not in the factor table

I cannot calculate the CBAM embedded emissions for this shipment under the supplied ruleset.

## Inputs check

| Required input | Provided | In table? | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| (a) Good CN code | 7208 (hot-rolled coil) | **No** | ❌ Missing |
| (b) Country of production | China | Listed for other codes, but not for 7208 | ❌ No SEE for 7208 + China |
| (c) Quantity | 5,000 t | n/a | ✅ OK |

## What is missing

1. **A default SEE for CN 7208 produced in China.** The table only covers CN 7201, 7206 10 00, 7207 11 90 and 7214 20 00. It has no entry for CN 7208 (flat-rolled products of iron or non-alloy steel, hot-rolled) for any country.
2. **The full CN code, if a more specific subheading applies.** Only the 4-digit heading "7208" was given. If a factor is added, the 8-digit code (e.g., 7208 xx xx) may be needed to pick the right row.

## Why I am not substituting another factor

The ruleset selects the SEE jointly by CN code and country. If an input is not in the table, no estimate is allowed. Using a nearby code, such as 7207 11 90 semi-finished products (3.314 tCO2e/t for China) or 7214 20 00 bars and rods (3.169 tCO2e/t for China), would be an estimate. It would not be a valid default value for hot-rolled coil.

## To proceed

Please provide the default SEE (tCO2e/t) for CN 7208, specified to the applicable 8-digit subheading, for production in China. I can then calculate:

Embedded emissions = SEE × 5,000 t, rounded half-up to 2 decimal places.
